description: This file defines the Footer class for the Opencart catalog's common controllers, responsible for generating the website footer content by loading language, model, gathering data, and rendering a view.

classes.name: Footer
classes.description: The Footer class extends the base Controller and assembles data to render the website footer, including links, scripts, user online tracking, and other footer information.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates footer data by loading language, models, creating links, tracking online users, and rendering the footer view.
